messages.subject: Problems with initialization of a  hierarchic model
parts:
I wrote the following RSTAN model in which a set of state variables (phi and consequently phi_sum) depend on stochastic parameters "salto" to be estimated.
The state variables at each time t are computed based on "salto" and then the observations N follow a low in which the state variables appear.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

data{

    int<lower=0> n;
    int<lower=0> s;
    int<lower=0> ngen;
    real<lower=0> dt;

    real<lower=0> N1[n];
    real<lower=0> N2[n];
    real<lower=0> N3[n];
    real<lower=0> N4[n];

    real<lower=0> ad[n];

    real<lower=0> sv1[n];
    real<lower=0> sv2[n];
    real<lower=0> sv3[n];
    real<lower=0> sv4[n];

    real<lower=0> stp1[n];
    real<lower=0> stp2[n];
    real<lower=0> stp3[n];
    real<lower=0> stp4[n];

    real<upper=0> v_sopr1[n];
    real<upper=0> v_sopr2[n];
    real<upper=0> v_sopr3[n];
    real<upper=0> v_sopr4[n];

    real<lower=0> coeff_diet[n];
    real fb0[n];

    real ef[s];

    real a1[s,n];
    real a2[s,n];
    real a3[s,n];
    real a4[s,n];

    real c1[s,n];
    real c2[s,n];
    real c3[s,n];
    real c4[s,n];

}


parameters{

    real<lower=0> alpha;

    real<lower=0> salto1[ngen];
    real<lower=0> salto2[ngen];
    real<lower=0> salto3[ngen];
    real<lower=0> salto4[ngen];

}

transformed parameters{

    real b1[s,ngen,n];
    real b2[s,ngen,n];
    real b3[s,ngen,n];
    real b4[s,ngen,n];

    real gg1[s,ngen,n];
    real gg2[s,ngen,n];
    real gg3[s,ngen,n];
    real gg4[s,ngen,n];

    real ww1[s,ngen,n];
    real ww2[s,ngen,n];
    real ww3[s,ngen,n];
    real ww4[s,ngen,n];

    real<lower=0> phi1[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi2[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi3[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi4[s,ngen,n];

  real<lower=0> phi1_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi2_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi3_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi4_sum[s,ngen,n];

    real fb_phi[s,ngen-1,n];

  real fb_phi_sum[s,ngen-1,n];

    for(t in 1:n){

        for(igen in 1:ngen){

            ##### coefficienti b #####

            b1[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv1[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t]) * dt + 1;
            b2[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv2[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t]) * dt + 1;
            b3[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv3[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t]) * dt + 1;
            b4[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv4[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t]) * dt + 1;
            for(i in 2:s-1){
                b1[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t]) * dt + 1;
                b2[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t]) * dt + 1;
                b3[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t]) * dt + 1;
                b4[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t]) * dt + 1;
            }
            b1[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t] + sv1[t]) * dt + 1;
            b2[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t] + sv2[t]) * dt + 1;
            b3[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t] + sv3[t]) * dt + 1;
            b4[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t] + sv4[t]) * dt + 1;

       
            ##### stadio 1 #####

            ww1[1,igen,t] <- c1[1,t]/b1[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww1[i,igen,t] <- c1[i,t]/(b1[i,igen,t]-a1[i,t]*ww1[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg1[1,igen,t] <- phi1[1,igen,t]/b1[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                   gg1[i,igen,t] <- (phi1[i,igen,t]-a1[i,t]*gg1[i-1,igen,t]) / (b1[i,igen,t]-a1[i,t]*ww1[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            ##### stadio 2 #####

            ww2[1,igen,t] <- c2[1,t]/b2[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww2[i,igen,t] <- c2[i,t]/(b2[i,igen,t]-a2[i,t]*ww2[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg2[1,igen,t] <- (phi2[1,igen,t] + dt*sv1[t]*phi1[s,igen,t]) / b2[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                   gg2[i,igen,t] <- (phi2[i,igen,t]-a2[i,t]*gg2[i-1,igen,t]) / (b2[i,igen,t]-a2[i,t]*ww2[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            ##### stadio 3 #####

            ww3[1,igen,t] <- c3[1,t]/b3[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww3[i,igen,t] <- c3[i,t]/(b3[i,igen,t]-a3[i,t]*ww3[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg3[1,igen,t] <- (phi3[1,igen,t] + dt*sv2[t]*phi2[s,igen,t]) / b3[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                gg3[i,igen,t] <- (phi3[i,igen,t]-a3[i,t]*gg3[i-1,igen,t]) / (b3[i,igen,t]-a3[i,t]*ww3[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            ##### stadio 4 #####

            ww4[1,igen,t] <- c4[1,t]/b4[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww4[i,igen,t] <- c4[i,t]/(b4[i,igen,t]-a4[i,t]*ww4[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg4[1,igen,t] <- (phi4[1,igen,t] + dt*sv3[t]*phi3[s,igen,t]) / b4[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                   gg4[i,igen,t] <- (phi4[i,igen,t]-a4[i,t]*gg4[i-1,igen,t]) / (b4[i,igen,t]-a4[i,t]*ww4[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

        } # for igen

        for(igen in 1:ngen-1){

            ##### produzione uova #####

            for(i in 1:s){
                fb_phi[i,igen,t] <- fb0[t]*ef[i]*coeff_diet[t]*phi4[i,igen,t];
            }

        }

    } # for t da 1

    phi1[1,1,1] <- 0;
    phi2[1,1,1] <- 0;
    phi3[1,1,1] <- 0;
    phi4[1,1,1] <- 0.5*s;
    for(igen in 2:ngen){
        phi1[1,igen,1] <- 0;
        phi2[1,igen,1] <- 0;
        phi3[1,igen,1] <- 0;
        phi4[1,igen,1] <- 0;
    }
    for(i in 2:s){
        for(igen in 1:ngen){
            phi1[i,igen,1] <- 0;
            phi2[i,igen,1] <- 0;
            phi3[i,igen,1] <- 0;
            phi4[i,igen,1] <- 0;
        }
    }

    for(t in 2:n){

        for(igen in 1:ngen){

            for(i in 1:s-1){
                phi1[i,igen,t] <- gg1[i,igen,t-1] - ww1[i,igen,t-1] * phi1[i+1,igen,t-1];
            }
            phi1[s,igen,t] <- gg1[s,igen,t-1];

            for(i in 1:s-1){
                phi2[i,igen,t] <- gg2[i,igen,t-1] - ww2[i,igen,t-1] * phi2[i+1,igen,t-1];
            }
            phi2[s,igen,t] <- gg2[s,igen,t-1];

            for(i in 1:s-1){
                phi3[i,igen,t] <- gg3[i,igen,t-1] - ww3[i,igen,t-1] * phi3[i+1,igen,t-1];
            }
            phi3[s,igen,t] <- gg3[s,igen,t-1];

        } # for igen

        phi4[1,1,t] <- gg4[1,1,t-1] - ww4[1,1,t-1] * phi4[2,1,t-1] + ad[t];
        for(i in 2:s-1){
            phi4[i,1,t] <- gg4[i,1,t-1] - ww4[i,1,t-1] * phi4[i+1,1,t-1];
        }
        phi4[s,1,t] <- gg4[s,1,t-1];
        for(igen in 2:ngen){
            for(i in 1:s-1){
                phi4[i,igen,t] <- gg4[i,igen,t-1] - ww4[i,igen,t-1] * phi4[i+1,igen,t-1];
            }
            phi4[s,igen,t] <- gg4[s,igen,t-1];
        }

    for(igen in 1:ngen){
      phi1_sum[1,igen,t] <- phi1[1,igen,t];
      phi2_sum[1,igen,t] <- phi2[1,igen,t];
      phi3_sum[1,igen,t] <- phi3[1,igen,t];
      phi4_sum[1,igen,t] <- phi4[1,igen,t];
        for(i in 2:s-1){
              phi1_sum[i,igen,t] <- phi1[i,igen,t] + phi1_sum[i-1,igen,t];
            phi2_sum[i,igen,t] <- phi2[i,igen,t] + phi2_sum[i-1,igen,t];
            phi3_sum[i,igen,t] <- phi3[i,igen,t] + phi3_sum[i-1,igen,t];
            phi4_sum[i,igen,t] <- phi4[i,igen,t] + phi4_sum[i-1,igen,t];
            }
    }
    phi1_sum[s,1,t] <- phi1[s,1,t] + phi1_sum[s-1,1,t];
    phi2_sum[s,1,t] <- phi2[s,1,t] + phi2_sum[s-1,1,t];
    phi3_sum[s,1,t] <- phi3[s,1,t] + phi3_sum[s-1,1,t];
    phi4_sum[s,1,t] <- phi4[s,1,t] + phi4_sum[s-1,1,t];
    for(igen in 2:ngen)
    {
      phi1_sum[s,igen,t] <- phi1[s,igen,t] + phi1_sum[s-1,igen,t] + phi1_sum[s,igen-1,t];
      phi2_sum[s,igen,t] <- phi2[s,igen,t] + phi2_sum[s-1,igen,t] + phi2_sum[s,igen-1,t];
      phi3_sum[s,igen,t] <- phi3[s,igen,t] + phi3_sum[s-1,igen,t] + phi3_sum[s,igen-1,t];
      phi4_sum[s,igen,t] <- phi4[s,igen,t] + phi4_sum[s-1,igen,t] + phi4_sum[s,igen-1,t];
    }

    for(igen in 1:ngen-1){
      fb_phi_sum[1,igen,t] <- fb_phi[1,igen,t];
      for(i in 2:s-1){
              fb_phi_sum[i,igen,t] <- fb_phi[i,igen,t] + fb_phi_sum[i-1,igen,t];
            }
    }
    fb_phi_sum[s,1,t] <- fb_phi[s,1,t] + fb_phi_sum[s-1,1,t];
    for(igen in 2:ngen-1)
    {
      fb_phi_sum[s,igen,t] <- fb_phi[s,igen,t] + fb_phi_sum[s-1,igen,t] + fb_phi_sum[s,igen-1,t];
    }

    } # for t da 2

}


model{

    alpha ~ gamma(1, 1);

    for (igen in 1:ngen){
        salto1[igen] ~ uniform(0.05,0.5);
        salto2[igen] ~ uniform(0.05,0.5);
        salto3[igen] ~ uniform(0.05,0.5);
        salto4[igen] ~ uniform(0.05,0.5);
    }

    for(t in 2:n){
        N1[t] ~ normal(phi1_sum[s,ngen,t]/s + fb_phi_sum[s,ngen-1,t]*0.5*dt/s, 1);
        N2[t] ~ normal(phi2_sum[s,ngen,t]/s, 1);
        N3[t] ~ normal(phi3_sum[s,ngen,t]/s, 1);
        N4[t] ~ normal(phi4_sum[s,ngen,t]/s, 1);
    }

}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The problem is that the chains are not correctly initalized and the sampling does not start.

I also tried to include an initialization as follows:

init_list = list(c1=list(alpha=1,
                         salto1=salto1_init,salto2=salto2_init,salto3=salto3_init,salto4=salto4_init,
                         b1=b1_init,b2=b2_init,b3=b3_init,b4=b4_init,
                         gg1=gg1_init,gg2=gg2_init,gg3=gg3_init,gg4=gg4_init,
                         ww1=ww1_init,ww2=ww2_init,ww3=ww3_init,ww4=ww4_init,
                         fb_phi=fb_phi_init,fb_phi_sum=fb_phi_sum_init,
                         phi1=phi1_init,phi2=phi2_init,phi3=phi3_init,phi4=phi4_init,
                         phi1_sum=phi1_sum_init,phi2_sum=phi2_sum_init,phi3_sum=phi3_sum_init,phi4_sum=phi4_sum_init))

where all parameters are equal to 1.
But also in this case I have some nan:0 that stop the algorithm.

I think that I miss some initializations.

I thank in advance for any useful suggestions.

Ettore

Hi Ettore,

Can you provide the full output? What you've provided isn't enough information to really help you out. My guess is that it's not an initialization problem but rather a misspecification of your Stan program, but it's really hard to guess what's wrong with that output.

For example, it would help to know which variables are nan. Have you tried printing this quantity and verifying that none of it is nan: phi1_sum[s,ngen,t]/s + fb_phi_sum[s,ngen-1,t]*0.5*dt/s?



Daniel

data{

    int<lower=0> s;
    int<lower=0> ngen;

}


parameters{

    real<lower=0> alpha;

    real<lower=0> salto1[ngen];
    real<lower=0> salto2[ngen];

    real<lower=0> salto4[ngen];

}

transformed parameters{

    real b1[s,ngen,n];
    real b2[s,ngen,n];
    real b3[s,ngen,n];
    real b4[s,ngen,n];

    real gg1[s,ngen,n];
    real gg2[s,ngen,n];
    real gg3[s,ngen,n];
    real gg4[s,ngen,n];

    real ww1[s,ngen,n];
    real ww2[s,ngen,n];
    real ww3[s,ngen,n];
    real ww4[s,ngen,n];

    real<lower=0> phi1[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi2[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi3[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi4[s,ngen,n];

  real<lower=0> phi1_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi2_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi3_sum[s,ngen,n];
    real<lower=0> phi4_sum[s,ngen,n];

    real fb_phi[s,ngen-1,n];

  real fb_phi_sum[s,ngen-1,n];

    for(t in 1:n){

        for(igen in 1:ngen){

            ##### coefficienti b #####

            b1[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv1[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t]) * dt + 1;
            b2[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv2[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t]) * dt + 1;
            b3[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv3[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t]) * dt + 1;
            b4[1,igen,t] <- (0.5*sv4[t] + 0.0001*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t]) * dt + 1;
            for(i in 2:s-1){
                b1[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t]) * dt + 1;
                b2[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t]) * dt + 1;
                b3[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t]) * dt + 1;
                b4[i,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t]) * dt + 1;
            }
            b1[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr1[t]+salto1[igen])*stp1[t] + sv1[t]) * dt + 1;
            b2[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr2[t]+salto2[igen])*stp2[t] + sv2[t]) * dt + 1;
            b3[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr3[t]+salto3[igen])*stp3[t] + sv3[t]) * dt + 1;
            b4[s,igen,t] <- (0.0002*s*s + (v_sopr4[t]+salto4[igen])*stp4[t] + sv4[t]) * dt + 1;

       
            ##### stadio 1 #####

            ww1[1,igen,t] <- c1[1,t]/b1[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww1[i,igen,t] <- c1[i,t]/(b1[i,igen,t]-a1[i,t]*ww1[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg1[1,igen,t] <- phi1[1,igen,t]/b1[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){

            }

            ##### stadio 2 #####

            ww2[1,igen,t] <- c2[1,t]/b2[1,igen,t];
            for(i in 2:s){
                ww2[i,igen,t] <- c2[i,t]/(b2[i,igen,t]-a2[i,t]*ww2[i-1,igen,t]);
            }

            gg2[1,igen,t] <- (phi2[1,igen,t] + dt*sv1[t]*phi1[s,igen,t]) / b2[1,igen,t];
